title: Add a comment to an OpenProject work package
description: On a work package page: opens the comment box (a button until clicked), waits for the rich-text editor, puts the text in, and posts it. Posting is the last step and runs only when the person asked for exactly that comment to be posted; without it the draft stays in the editor for the person to review. Matched on any domain by OpenProject's page metadata.

params.name: text
params.description: The comment. HTML is allowed (paragraphs, lists, bold, links) and lands formatted.

steps.note: The comment box is a button until clicked.
Posts the comment for everyone on the work package.
